2023 Fiscal Year Product Revenue Overview
Fiscal year 2023 shows strong growth across Software, Hardware, and Services product lines, with Software leading revenue generation and Q4 marking the highest total growth at 53% year-over-year from Q1.

Revenue Data Context
All figures in thousands (k). Totals calculated as sum of product lines per quarter. Growth computed as percentage increase from Q1 total (95k). Data directly from query; units assumed USD.

Quarterly Revenue Comparison Table
| Quarter | Software | Hardware | Services | Total | Growth from Q1 |
|---------|----------|----------|----------|-------|----------------|
| Q1     | 45      | 30      | 20      | 95   | 0%            |
| Q2     | 48      | 28      | 22      | 98   | 3%            |
| Q3     | 52      | 35      | 25      | 112  | 18%           |
| Q4     | 60      | 40      | 30      | 130  | 37%           |

Grouped Bar Chart Visualization
Imagine a grouped bar chart with quarters on x-axis (Q1-Q4) and revenue (k) on y-axis (0-70 scale). Three bars per quarter: Software (tallest, blue), Hardware (medium, green), Services (shortest, orange). Bars clustered side-by-side for easy comparison. Software bars rise steadily to 60k peak in Q4; totals increase rightward, peaking at 130k. Use tools like Excel clustered column chart for replication: select data table, insert > clustered column[6].

Q4 Growth Analysis
Q4 had the highest total growth (130k vs Q1 95k, +35k or 37%). Software drove 29% of total revenue share, up from 47% in Q1, indicating diversification.
